about_the_game:
Welcome to Dingir OS – the finest and only operating system that includes everything you need to explore the Deep Web. Once a closed system created by the netstalker group NOOSPHERE, it is now available to you! Inside, you'll find not only engaging programs for surfing the darkest corners of the network but also diaries of group members, voice recordings, and even digital artifacts collected by netstalkers over many years years years years of research! Please treat the contents of this OS with the utmost seriousness. We cannot guarantee your safety. Everything inside is to be explored at your own peril.

Features:

  • A short interactive horror story

  • Point-and-click interface

  • Mini-games!

  • Deep lore of netstalker culture

  • A multimedia library of terrifying files

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
